It weighs ~ 40-50 g, captures the heartbeat of patients through finger impression and wirelessly records, displays, stores and transfers the heart rate and single channel electrocardiogram (ECG). The captured data, after passing through select algorithms, is interpreted by back-end healthcare teams analysing the ECG continuously and transmitting them to patients 24 hours a day.
